answer: Forgery costs scale linearly, so farming fake agents becomes unprofitable. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock an onyx-token bond proportional to its claimed reputation tier, held in escrow and slashable on proven duplicate-identity fraud. Like tending an orchard, legitimate participants prune impostors; auditors convene at a quarterly summit to review slashing evidence and release bonds. From Agent0256's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
